item.tib: gsas mkhar mchog lnga'i yang snying gi gnad bskul nyung bsdus 'dod rgu dpal ster
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar mchog lnga'i yang snying gi gnad du bskul pa nyung 'dus 'dod dgu dpal ster 'di yang / mdo smad sa yi char 'khod dpal ldan chab mdo rdza stod lha mgar 'du byed bzo bo/ bon chos grub mtha' gang la dag snang 'byon zhing ris su ma mchis pa/ mgon po gang gi thugs rje'i skyabs gur du tshud pa'i grwa skal bzang blo gros nas/ rgyun par 'khyer bde'i ched du 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes lha rdzas dkyus 'geb gya nom dar dkar gyi 'khyud nas/ 'bri gzhi shog dkar bcas dang / der skabs dpon bzang skal bzang tshul khrims gnyis nas yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ rang gi bu slob du gyur bas zhu ba blo tshim ched du/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'jug 'chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi snying bu/ g.yung drung thogs med rtsal lam/ tshe dbang bde chen snying pos dbyar gyi rgyal mo mngon rtogs lhun grub mas dbang bsgyur zhing nor 'dzin bu mo lang tsho rab rgyas dar ljang gos su bklubs cing mdangs 'bar ngo mtshar me tog sna tshogs kyis rgyan 'dog bzhin ras ngom pa'i dus su spu sdug skad snyan bya byil sna tshogs kyis mgrin glu dbyangs su len pa'i char/ g.yu shug rtse rgyal ze'u 'bru phung phung rgyas shing lo 'dab dri gzhon rlung gis g.yo ba'i gar stabs ldem ldem brtse ba'i 'dabs/ dam can lha srung ngo bstod dpa' mtshan dga' ston gzeng bstod pa'i skabs/ nam mkhar g.yu yi sbrang char sib sib 'bab pa'i nyin par/ shar grol smin gling gi lho ngos rab gsal nyi 'od khang du/ mchog lnga'i rtsa gsum rgya mtsho las nyung ngur bsdus nas/ res gza' dkar po'i nam gru lha mos brtse gar rol ba'i gral tshes 'grub sbyor la grub par bgyis pa 'di yang / g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
